en.t: Suddenly he thought of Lady Murasaki:

units.source_text: 这几天我常在宫中，久不回二条院，想她是闷闷不乐了。”

en.t: These past few days I have often been at the palace and have not returned to Nijo for a long time; she must be feeling unhappy and neglected.
He felt deeply sorry for her.

units.source_text: 拿出那把证物的扇子来看看，

en.t: He took out the fan that served as evidence and looked at it,

units.source_text: 但见两根外骨上各装着三片樱花模样的饰物，扎着五色丝线。

en.t: and saw that each of the two outer ribs was fitted with three cherry blossom shaped ornaments, tied with threads of five colors.

units.source_text: 浓色的一面上用泥金画着一个朦胧淡月，

en.t: On the darker side, a hazy pale moon had been painted in gold pigment,
and its reflection shimmered in the water.
The design was not especially novel,

units.source_text: 然而此乃美人惯用之物，自有亲切可爱之感。

en.t: yet because it was an object habitually used by a beautiful woman, it naturally had a feeling of intimacy and charm.

units.source_text: 那个吟唱“料汝无缘扫墓来”的人的面影，始终不离开他的心头。

en.t: The image of the person who had sung, "I suppose you will have no chance to come and sweep my grave," never left his heart.

units.source_text: 他便在扇头添写两句诗：

en.t: So he added two lines of verse at the end of the fan:
